items:
BEACH HOUSE
Luxurious contemporary 4 bedroom, 3.5 bathroom beach house with a new 6 Seat Golf Cart in the unique Inspiration neighborhood within the Sandestin Resort beach community. Contemporary and updated design and decorating. Recently renovated kitchen cabinets, island and countertops. This fabulously decorated beach home has every luxury amenity you need! The 4 large bedrooms include: 2 Master Suites each with King Size Beds, 1 Deluxe King Size Bed Guest Room and 1 Bunk Bedroom with 2 new Twin XL's over Queen Size Bunk Beds. The beautifully decorated 3.5 bathrooms feature designer soap, shampoo, conditioner, body wash & lotion, luxury bath towels as well as hair dryers. The open designed living room, dining room & professional kitchen with high ceilings is very comfortable for a few or perfect for entertaining several. The living room includes a cozy gas fire place and cable TV with all channels including HBO, Showtime, Cinemax, Starz, The Movie Channel, Netflix & Amazon Prime. The designer coastal dining table accommodates 8 and the kitchen bar has seating for 4. The professional kitchen is fully equipped with top of the line Sub Zero & Viking appliances, J.A. Henkels chef's knives and a complete set of Cuisinart professional cookware. A Sonos home sound system provides premium wireless music throughout the home, allowing you to play your saved or streamed music from your devices. The 2 relaxing outdoor screened porches, downstairs & upstairs, provide an experience of secluded serenity to enjoy the outdoors with screened protection. The porches feature teak & wicker deep seating, rockers, a hammock, teak outdoor dining and professional Weber gas grill with side burner. The rear porches enjoy a secluded view of Burnt Pine Golf Course's 16th hole and the front porch views the Choctawhatchee Bay. The beautiful white powdery sand and emerald water beach is just a short 5 minutes from the house. A 6 person Golf Cart is Included for your use throughout the resort with the beach, activities, dining & shopping just a few minutes to everything!

INSPIRATION NEIGHBORHOOD
Inspiration is a unique exclusive neighborhood that is a private resort within the Sandestin Resort, including premium amenities! There is no other neighborhood or development in Sandestin that provides personal amenity service like Inspiration! The central location is near the Beach, Bay, activities, restaurants & shopping. 20 upscale contemporary homes located on the Bay, surround a private clubhouse with your personal concierge staff, a private heated & chilled pool steps away from your front door with a hot tub, well equipped fitness room and private onsite massage. Bicycles are free and included in your stay at Inspiration. A private pier exclusively for Inspiration residents extends into the Bay with perfect amazing sunsets, fishing or crabbing. Personal concierges are at your service for any of your needs during your stay for information, reservations, scheduling massages on property and extra household items. A weekly resident party on Tuesday afternoons features complimentary food, drinks & live music. Every Sunday afternoon is "Sundae's on Sunday" where the staff will make you a complimentary sundae with the toppings of your choice!

SANDESTIN BEACH RESORT
Sandestin is the #1 upscale resort on Florida's Emerald Coast located in Miramar Beach, enjoying direct access to the resort's powdery white expansive beach & beautiful emerald water on the Gulf of Mexico and the Choctawhatchee Bay. On the beach, The Beach House Bar & Grill provides a relaxing break with the best views of the beautiful water. Sandestin has 4 award winning championship golf courses, a Top 25 U.S. Tennis Resort with a15 court tennis center and a colorful 123 slip Baytowne Marina with the Marina Bar & Grill. 3 lifestyle developments in the resort, the Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grand Boulevard and the Market Shops offer a variety of retail shopping, an assortment of casual to upscale restaurants and entertainment all within 2 - 3 minutes of your front door. Each is accessible by golf cart, bicycle, car or a short walk. Wide sidewalks throughout the 2,400 acre resort are perfect for exercise, running, walking or bicycling. Fishing charters, tackle, rod rentals, paddle boards, wave runners, kayaks and boat rentals are available at the Baytowne Marina. Catch & release fishing is allowed in any of the multiple golf course lakes. 2 spas in the resort, Spa Lilliana at the Hotel Effie and Serenity by the Sea in the Hilton Sandestin are available for pampering in paradise. Free outdoor live music concerts are featured weekly at The Village of Baytowne Wharf's Events Plaza stage on Wednesday nights and at Baytowne LIVE stage on Tuesday & Thursday nights. During the summer months, Baytowne offers events nightly such as fireworks, Hydroflight and magic shows. One Thursday every month is Bubbly Baytowne, where shop owners offer free champagne to sip & shop! During the winter months, ice skating at Baytowne on Ice rink is available. Literally everything you need for your vacation without leaving the resort!

This luxury home is truly comfortable, relaxing and large enough for privacy. Perfect for romantic getaways, couples trips, family vacations and friend trips. This oasis within the resort is truly a unique luxury experience. Once you've experienced Inspiration and Sandestin you will want to return again and again!
